rubric: The workshop title is clearly the dominant element and is much larger than every other piece of text.
The date, time and place are easy to find, grouped together, and use no more than about three levels of emphasis overall.
Lines are set comfortably: sensible line length and line-height, no awkward one-word last lines, and no clipped or cramped text.
The card uses a small, consistent set of type styles (one or two families, few sizes and weights) with consistent alignment.
All text, including the smallest line, has strong contrast and is readable at phone size.

result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): A's title is larger and more commanding, and it fills the square well. The date, time and place sit in clear cards with strong contrast, though the 'Sign Up Now!' line is cramped and the cards add several levels of emphasis. B is clean and consistent, but its content is small and floats in a lot of empty space. Its small labels and salmon URL have weaker contrast, and the orange time adds an extra level of emphasis to the details block. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A has a calmer layout: the date, time and place sit together in one centered stack, and it uses few type styles. Its weak points are the small text floating in a lot of empty space and the faint brown labels and coral URL, which are low-contrast on the beige background. B has a larger title and better contrast on its white cards, but it feels crowded: 'Sign Up Now!' is jammed between two boxes, the time is set very small, and the card mixes more styles (italic text, badges, emoji labels, outlined and filled boxes).
